summary: A birth becomes a state record: the law requires a certificate for every birth.
realLife: State law requires a birth certificate to be completed for every birth, and the state forms feed a national count.
sources: CDC National Center for Health Statistics, NVSS Birth Data: https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/births.htm
inGame: the people module's life records, read by lifeOf in src/bench/loading.ts (the born/born event, with its year).
